name: Zibtek - Software Company in Salt Lake City
old_description: Since 2009, we've used our real-world experience of founding, building, and exiting multiple companies to lead the digital transformation of our clients through custom software development services. We're a software company in Salt Lake City UT that has the talent you need to jumpstart your next project immediately.
about:
Zibtek was founded in 2009 in Salt Lake City, Utah. The company was established by entrepreneurs with experience founding, building, and exiting multiple businesses, though individual founders are not named in public materials.

The firm provides custom software development services including web and mobile application development, ERP development, API development, microservices architecture, and QA/QC support. It follows a practical agile methodology and offers staff augmentation — covering design, development, project management, DevOps, and testing — with resources available in‑country, nearshore, and offshore. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Zibtek serves clients across healthcare technology (FormFox, an employee health and safety workflow provider), social media (Awsm, a private family‑group app), productivity software (Promptly Journals, a journaling app), and financial services (Academy Mortgage). The company emphasizes its local Utah presence for on‑site collaboration with regional businesses.

Zibtek states its differentiation lies in end‑to‑end product ownership, a rigorous hiring process that yields autonomous engineers, and a practical agile approach designed to reduce time‑to‑market while maintaining flexibility. The firm also highlights its local Salt Lake City base as a source of faster on‑site implementation and cost efficiency.
